lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of large, high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The nodes are spaced with roughly equidistant horizontal and vertical intervals, forming a primary 4x5 grid within the central flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal sequences of blobs, creating a grid-like matrix where high-luminance clusters serve as anchor nodes at the intersection of lighter-blue interstitial lines.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running parallel to the lateral line. Each ridge is defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, featuring high-pixel-intensity highlights on the dorsal surface and low-intensity shadows on the ventral surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots is visible across the lateral silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with clustering observed along the basal region and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-frequency cluster of smaller-diameter luminance spots is concentrated in the immediate post-branchial zone, forming a dense transition pattern between the fifth gill slit and the primary lateral grid.
